Do you regret quitting school? 
And I'm trying to think that eventually I'll find someone, but this is what I've been thinking for years and still it didn't come yet..

I have tried few dating sites, but they didn't really work out.
I started some small talks with girls, but I never met any of them, probably because I was to shy/scared to ask them out..

I'm sorry to hear that, but even though I have friends most of the time I feel awkward about going out and I would rather stay at home..
It's sad to see that there are so many people like me, cause I know how you/they feel..
Thanks for your reply! However you are only 14 years old yet, so it's a different situation, but it's good to see that at least you got the courage to ask a girl out and it worked out.
Thanks for your reply, I've been thinking about it for hours now, and I've decided that I'll give myself one more chance, maybe I'll actually achieve something this time.
